answer_1.quote: We focus on the classical generative Seq2Seq dialogue model for single-turn dialogue generation ... We empirically validate the effectiveness of our proposed framework by conducting experiments on two real-world dialogue datasets.

answer_2.quote: For relevance, we report the BLEU score between generated responses and ground truths. For diversity, we report the metric "Distinct" ... Offense Rate, Sentiment, Career Word, and Family Word are also measured for fairness evaluation.
